component.name: Akousma
component.summary: A music player and collection organizer

description.p: Akousma is a music player and music collection organizer, based on Strawberry Music Player by Jonas Kvinge and contributors. It is aimed at music collectors and audiophiles. Akousma is free software released under GPL. It's written in C++ using the Qt framework and GStreamer.

ul.li: Supports most popular audio formats and CD playback
Playlist management and playlists in multiple formats
Advanced audio output and device configuration for bit-perfect playback on Linux
Album cover art from Last.fm, Musicbrainz, Discogs, Musixmatch, Deezer, Tidal, Qobuz and Spotify
Transfer music to mass-storage USB players, MTP compatible devices and iPod Nano/Classic
Scrobbler with support for Last.fm and ListenBrainz
Unofficial streaming support for Tidal, Spotify and Qobuz
